name: CO2 dedamoji of the excise duty on gas oils
law: Akcizų įstatymas Nr. IX-569, 37 straipsnio 1 dalis and 3 priedas: the excise duty on gas oils (diesel) has a fixed part and a variable CO2 part (CO2 dedamoji), EUR 53.6 per 1,000 litres in 2025 (introduced on 1 January 2025), as the customs department's notice gives it. The excise payer passes it on in the pump price, so a trip pays it where its fuel is bought. Litres are the trip's road fuel as given (diesel_l), or its tank-to-wheel CO2 at 2.67 kg per litre of diesel (EN 16258:2012).

sources.title: Muitinės departamentas: Dėl Akcizų įstatymo tam tikrų nuostatų pasikeitimo nuo 2026-01-01 (notice): the CO2 component of the excise duty on gas oils kept in 2026 at its 2025 amount, per 1,000 litres (read in Chrome: tools/tables/browser/lt-muitine-akcizai-2026.txt)
